bullets.text: Smart Livestock Monitoring Launched — Boldyn Networks and West Sussex County Council are using 5G technology to enhance livestock monitoring, improving animal welfare and farm resilience amid climate challenges.
Project Gigabit Progress Reported — Building Digital UK announced that over 296,000 premises have been connected under the £5 billion broadband initiative, improving internet access across the UK.
Huawei and HP Patent Agreement — A new patent cross-licensing deal between Huawei and HP Inc. allows both companies to share Wi-Fi technology innovations, impacting the tech industry broadly.
MWC26 Doha Event Announced — The GSMA's MWC26 will co-locate with the ITU Plenipotentiary Conference, uniting global leaders to discuss digital policy and connectivity advancements.
